reason: The original MSVCRT free helper legitimately overwrites its own caller-provided argument slot. Observer incorrectly required slot preservation at return. Corrected observer preserves input identity separately, retains actual returned slot, and checks cdecl stack balance. No reconstruction or shared-CRT code was changed for this observer correction.
